name: Sygg
description: A ferry captain on the Merrow Lanes.

description_citations.text: "Vendilion clique". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Sygg are part of the group that brought down Oona; Brigid once sailed as a pirate under Sygg.
timeline.quote: A principled member of the group responsible for Oona's downfall

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Holding Sygg's Crescent, Brigid meets the Source of the Wanderwine and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.
timeline.quote: which enabled her to survive the change between Lorwyn to Shadowmoor with her memories, abilities, and physical image intact.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid knocks Sygg out to save Jack's life.
timeline.quote: When Sygg wanted to kill Jack, Brigid knocked him out to save Jack's life.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
timeline.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The triplets meet Ashling on a ferry and save the passengers from an arbomander.
timeline.quote: They saved her and the other passengers when the ferry was attacked by an arbomander

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Brigid remembers her time as a pirate under Sygg.
relations.quote: she wistfully remembers her time as a pirate under Sygg.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

relations.note: They investigate the merrows together and she joins his crew.
relations.quote: Together, they set off to investigate strange occurrences affecting the merrows.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
